model.title: A bill to extend the authority for modifications to the Second Division Memorial in the District of Columbia.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Lisa Murkowski (R-AK)

summary.text: The bill would extend the authority for the Second Indianhead Division Association to make modifications to the Second Division Memorial in Washington, D.C., allowing the organization to add commemorative elements or engravings honoring fallen members of the Second Infantry Division.
